visual_observations: Vaseline Healthy Bright Gluta-Hya Serum Burst UV Lotion squeeze tube packaging (~199.4 mm height).
Base closure: White flip-top dispensing cap (~24 mm height, Y ~ -100 to -76 mm) with flat standing foot.
Shoulder transition: Chamfered stepped neck transition (Y ~ -76 to -71 mm) connecting cap to tube body.
Flexible tube body: Widening ergonomic squeeze tube container with prominent Vaseline Gluta-Hya branding graphics.
Top closure: Flat ribbed heat-sealed crimp seal end (Y ~ 90 to 99.5 mm) with fine vertical crimp serrations.
